citaat: Assignments contain 17-25 questions with up to 5,000-6,000 words total, requiring lecturers to spend multiple days correcting each batch.
samenvatting: Een batch nakijken kost docenten meerdere dagen per keer.

citaat: The institute corrects approximately 1,000 assignments per year across approximately 200 students. Manual assessment is time-consuming and requires consistent feedback quality across 20+ teaching staff members.
samenvatting: 1.000 opdrachten per jaar, consistentie over 20+ losse docenten is het probleem.

citaat: CMI recently tested another AI solution that generated approximately 80% unsuitable feedback requiring significant human editing. Only approximately 20% of the AI feedback was genuinely useful.
samenvatting: Vorige AI-tool leverde 80% onbruikbare feedback op, dat is hun referentie.

citaat: The AI frequently indicated passes where human assessors identified significant deficiencies, creating conflicting outcomes.
samenvatting: Vorige tool gaf passes waar de beoordelaar zakte, dat vertrouwen is weg.

citaat: CMI emphasizes that AI effectiveness directly impacts assessor workload: 99% accuracy reduces correction time, while 50% accuracy actually increases assessor work and costs.
samenvatting: Half werkende AI kost hen juist meer tijd, dat is hun angst.

citaat: CMI expects feedback structured like a hamburger: introductory sentence restating requirements, main section identifying strengths and weaknesses, and conclusion stating pass status with justification. Feedback should distinguish between mandatory changes and optional enhancements.
samenvatting: Vaste feedbackstructuur met verplicht versus optioneel is hun eis.

citaat: The tool normalizes feedback language and tone across lecturers, which some teachers viewed as constraining their individual voice.
samenvatting: Gestandaardiseerde toon voelt voor docenten als verlies van eigen stem.

citaat: Presented Eduface's custom academic AI model trained with universities, achieving 89% grading consistency across teachers at Bergstra University.
samenvatting: Wij verkochten hier op consistentie tussen docenten, niet op tijdwinst.

citaat: CMI requires accuracy in the late 80s percentage range with only minor editing needed (10-15% editing maximum) to be viable. If editing requirements exceed 15%, the tool becomes counterproductive.
samenvatting: Harde grens: max 10-15% bijwerken, anders is het dubbel werk.

citaat: Seamless Moodle integration is essential, allowing the tool to work in the background without additional user effort.
samenvatting: Moodle-integratie zonder extra handelingen is een koopvoorwaarde.

citaat: Grammar and spelling feedback is already provided through Copyleaks reports, so Eduface should not duplicate this functionality.
samenvatting: Copyleaks dekt spelling al, daar moeten wij niet overheen gaan.

citaat: CMI uses a grading system with pass and refer (not yet achieved), allowing students to resubmit after receiving feedback. The ideal workflow involves students submitting assignments, AI providing feedback, and lecturers reviewing for minimal adjustments.
samenvatting: Herkansingsmodel met refer maakt snelle formatieve feedback waardevol.
